whenToUse: A full-page support ticket with SLA clocks, email-style thread and internal notes.
Agents replying with macros, setting next status and checking the requester's account.
avoidWhen: Monitoring many tickets' SLAs — use dashboard-10.
A simple discussion under a record — use comment-thread.
a11y: The composer mode and status changes are announced via aria-live; thread has headings.
Make internal notes visually and textually distinct so they are never sent by mistake.
